sentences.cn: 但在那时候，2006年？

sentences.en: It was a different world.
sentences.cn: 是完全不同的世界。

sentences.en: You didn’t do that.
sentences.cn: 你不能那么干。

sentences.en: Especially not at United.
sentences.cn: 在曼联尤其不能。

sentences.en: Not in Roy’s dressing room.
sentences.cn: 在罗伊的更衣室里更不能。

sentences.en: It was one of a thousand mistakes that I made when I was at United.
sentences.cn: 那只是我在曼联犯下的一千个错误之一。

sentences.en: It wasn’t just the football that was difficult.
sentences.cn: 难的不只是足球。

sentences.en: It was the language and the culture and the loneliness.
sentences.cn: 还有语言、文化，和孤独。

sentences.en: The isolation was the worst part.
sentences.cn: 孤立无援是最难熬的部分。

sentences.en: Being away from your family at 17, and being surrounded by grown men, by legends, by a manager like Sir Alex…
sentences.cn: 十七岁就离开家人，身边全是成年人、传奇球星，还有弗格森爵士那样的主教练……

sentences.en: it was very complicated.
sentences.cn: 那种滋味非常复杂。

sentences.en: When people wonder why talented young footballers don’t make it abroad, I can assure you it usually doesn’t have anything to do with their technical quality.
sentences.cn: 当人们疑惑为什么有天赋的年轻球员出国就踢不出来，我可以向你保证：通常跟他们的技术水平毫无关系。

sentences.en: There’s always a lot more going on that you don’t see.
sentences.cn: 总有很多你看不见的东西在起作用。

sentences.en: The first two years I was in England, there were so many nights when I would come home from training and in Manchester it would already be dark outside at four in the afternoon, and I would be in my flat all alone.
sentences.cn: 在英格兰的头两年，有太多这样的夜晚：训练完回到家，曼彻斯特下午四点天已经黑透了，我一个人待在公寓里。

sentences.en: It was depressing.
sentences.cn: 非常压抑。

sentences.en: Then, of course, my mother would call me, and I’d lie and say, “Oh no, it’s going great, Mum.
sentences.cn: 然后当然，我妈会打电话来，我撒谎说：“没事，一切都好，妈。

sentences.en: Everything is great.”
sentences.cn: 好得很。”

sentences.en: But it wasn’t going great.
sentences.cn: 但其实一点也不好。

sentences.en: It was shit.
sentences.cn: 糟糕透了。

sentences.en: I wanted to quit and come home to Spain.
sentences.cn: 我想过放弃，回西班牙老家。

sentences.en: I remember during that time, my father always said something to me that was extremely important.
sentences.cn: 我记得那段时间，我父亲总对我说一句话，那句话对我极其重要。

sentences.en: I’d complain to him, “I don’t know, Dad.
sentences.cn: 我跟他抱怨：“我不知道，爸。

sentences.en: The manager doesn’t trust me.
sentences.cn: 主教练不信任我。

sentences.en: These guys are so strong.
sentences.cn: 这帮人身体太壮了。

sentences.en: I’m miserable.”
sentences.cn: 我很痛苦。”

sentences.en: And he would say, “Well, you know what?
sentences.cn: 而他会说：“哎，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Maybe today was bad.
sentences.cn: 也许今天很糟。

sentences.en: But the sun will always rise again tomorrow.”
sentences.cn: 但太阳明天总会照常升起。”

sentences.en: I don’t know why, but it made me feel better.
sentences.cn: 不知为什么，这让我好受多了。

sentences.en: It kept me going.
sentences.cn: 它支撑着我走下去。

sentences.en: And I was very lucky, because, as naive as I was, and as raw as I was, Sir Alex was phenomenal to me from the very first day.
sentences.cn: 我也非常幸运，因为尽管我那时又天真又毛糙，弗格森爵士从第一天起就对我好得不得了。

sentences.en: The best managers all have this quality — even when they’re not playing you, and even when they’re hard on you — they make you believe that they really care about you.
sentences.cn: 最好的主教练都有这个特质——哪怕不让你上场，哪怕对你很严厉——他们都能让你相信，他们是真心在乎你的。

sentences.en: Sir Alex was like a second father to me.
sentences.cn: 对我来说，弗格森就像第二个父亲。

sentences.en: He made me earn it, but eventually he gave me my chance.
sentences.cn: 他让我一步步去挣，但最终他给了我机会。

sentences.en: In 2007, after two years in England, he told me that I was going to play about 25 games that season.
sentences.cn: 2007年，在英格兰待了两年之后，他告诉我，那个赛季我会踢大约25场球。

sentences.en: Everything started well.
sentences.cn: 一开始一切顺利。

sentences.en: I was getting to play a bit alongside Rio.
sentences.cn: 我开始能跟里奥搭档着打一些比赛。

sentences.en: And then, in November, we went to play in Bolton.
sentences.cn: 然后，11月，我们去博尔顿打客场。

sentences.en: Shit…
sentences.cn: 糟了……

sentences.en: I can still picture the ball floating in the air.
sentences.cn: 我到现在还能想起那个球飘在空中的样子。

sentences.en: It was a set piece.
sentences.cn: 那是个定位球。

sentences.en: I was supposed to be marking Nicolas Anelka.
sentences.cn: 我本该盯防尼古拉·阿内尔卡。

sentences.en: Bolton chipped the ball into the box, and I thought, I’m going to be aggressive.
sentences.cn: 博尔顿把球吊进禁区，我心想，我要主动出击。

sentences.en: I jumped up to head the ball away, and I completely missed it.
sentences.cn: 我跳起来想头球解围，结果完全顶空了。

sentences.en: It was like something out of a nightmare.
sentences.cn: 就像噩梦里的场景。

sentences.en: The ball just…
sentences.cn: 那个球就……

sentences.en: kept floating.
sentences.cn: 一直飘着。

sentences.en: It was that yellow and purple Premier League ball.
sentences.cn: 就是那种黄紫相间的英超用球。

sentences.en: Remember that one?
sentences.cn: 还记得那个球吗？

sentences.en: It floated right over my head like a balloon.
sentences.cn: 它像个气球一样，从我头顶飘了过去。

sentences.en: I landed and turned around in horror.
sentences.cn: 我落地，惊恐地回头。

sentences.en: Anelka controlled the ball and scored easily.
sentences.cn: 阿内尔卡停球，轻松破门。

sentences.en: We ended up losing 1-0, and it was my fault.
sentences.cn: 我们最后0比1输了，那是我的错。

sentences.en: As a young defender, when you make a mistake like that, the manager simply cannot trust you anymore.
sentences.cn: 作为一个年轻后卫，当你犯下那种错误，主教练就再也无法信任你了。

sentences.en: Even if he wants to trust you, he can’t.
sentences.cn: 哪怕他想信任你，也做不到了。

sentences.en: I could tell, literally at the moment that Anelka controlled the ball, that I had lost the faith of Sir Alex, and probably the faith of most United fans.
sentences.cn: 阿内尔卡停球的那一刻我就知道，我失去了弗格森爵士的信任，很可能也失去了大多数曼联球迷的信任。

sentences.en: Sir Alex promised me 25 games that season, and I ended up getting 12.
sentences.cn: 弗格森爵士答应过那个赛季给我25场，最后我只踢了12场。

sentences.en: It was an extremely difficult time.
sentences.cn: 那是极其难熬的一段时间。

sentences.en: That mistake felt like the end of my career.
sentences.cn: 那次失误感觉就像职业生涯的终结。

sentences.en: It ended up being the beginning of it, but only because of what Sir Alex Ferguson did for me.
sentences.cn: 结果它成了职业生涯的开端——而这全靠弗格森爵士为我做的事。

sentences.en: You see, toward the end of that season, my agent told me that Barcelona were interested in bringing me back.
sentences.cn: 你看，那个赛季快结束时，我的经纪人告诉我，巴萨有意把我带回去了。

sentences.en: Truthfully, I could not believe it.
sentences.cn: 说实话，我根本不敢相信。

sentences.en: My exact words to him were, “That doesn’t make sense.
sentences.cn: 我对他说的原话是：“这不合理。

sentences.en: I’m not playing at United, so why would they want me?”
sentences.cn: 我在曼联都踢不上球，他们要我干嘛？”

sentences.en: And he said, “Well, they know you.
sentences.cn: 而他说：“哎，他们了解你。

sentences.en: They believe in you.”
sentences.cn: 他们相信你。”

sentences.en: Of course, I was thrilled.
sentences.cn: 我当然欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: I wanted to go home.
sentences.cn: 我想回家。

sentences.en: But I knew that I had to have a very difficult conversation with Sir Alex.
sentences.cn: 但我知道，我必须跟弗格森爵士谈一次非常艰难的话。

sentences.en: There was no buyout clause in my contract, and United could set whatever price they wanted, so I had to convince him to let me go.
sentences.cn: 我的合同里没有买断条款，曼联想开什么价就开什么价，所以我必须说服他放我走。

sentences.en: It was one of the hardest conversations of my life, because he took such great care of me.
sentences.cn: 那是我人生中最艰难的对话之一，因为他此前待我那么好。

sentences.en: But I walked into his office, and I was honest with him.
sentences.cn: 但我走进他的办公室，对他坦白了。

sentences.en: I said, “Listen, I feel like I’ve lost your trust.
sentences.cn: 我说：“听着，我感觉我已经失去了您的信任。

sentences.en: Barcelona is my home.
sentences.cn: 巴萨是我的家。

sentences.en: I want to go back.
sentences.cn: 我想回去。

sentences.en: I hope you will let me go.”
sentences.cn: 我希望您放我走。”

sentences.en: We had a long conversation, and he decided that I was sincere, and he agreed to let me leave at the end of the season.
sentences.cn: 我们谈了很久，他认定我是真诚的，同意赛季末放我离开。

sentences.en: But that’s not the end of our story.
sentences.cn: 但我们的故事还没完。

sentences.en: Football can be very complicated.
sentences.cn: 足球可以是件非常复杂的事。

sentences.en: At the end of that season, guess who we had to face in the semi finals of the Champions League?
sentences.cn: 那个赛季末，猜猜我们在欧冠半决赛碰上的是谁？

sentences.en: Of course, it was Barcelona.
sentences.cn: 当然是巴萨。

sentences.en: I had no real chance of playing.
sentences.cn: 我根本没有上场的机会。

sentences.en: I was the third-choice centre back.
sentences.cn: 我是第三号中卫。

sentences.en: But right before the first leg at the Camp Nou, Nemanja Vidić came down with an injury.
sentences.cn: 可就在诺坎普首回合开打之前，内马尼亚·维迪奇伤了。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, I was going to have to step up and play in front of 90,000 people, against my boyhood club.
sentences.cn: 突然之间，我得站出来，在九万人面前，对阵我少年时代的俱乐部。

sentences.en: I was excited, nervous, shocked…
sentences.cn: 我又兴奋，又紧张，又震惊……

sentences.en: everything.
sentences.cn: 什么情绪都有。

sentences.en: Before the match, we had our usual two-hour siesta at the hotel.
sentences.cn: 赛前我们在酒店照例午休两个小时。

sentences.en: Of course, I couldn’t sleep.
sentences.cn: 我当然睡不着。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, there’s a knock at the door, and I look out the little hole…
sentences.cn: 突然有人敲门，我从门上的小孔往外看……

sentences.en: It’s not the maid.
sentences.cn: 不是客房服务员。

sentences.en: It’s Sir Alex.
sentences.cn: 是弗格森爵士。

sentences.en: I knew something was going on, because he never came to see players before the match.
sentences.cn: 我知道出事了，因为他从不在赛前找球员。

sentences.en: I opened the door and he said, “Gerard, I regret to inform you that I can’t play you today.
sentences.cn: 我打开门，他说：“杰拉德，我很遗憾地通知你，今天我不能派你上场。

sentences.en: The deal is almost done.
sentences.cn: 转会快谈成了。

sentences.en: If I play you, and you have a bad game, they’ll say it’s because you’re headed to Barcelona.
sentences.cn: 如果我让你上场，你又踢砸了，人们会说你是因为要去巴萨。

sentences.en: So I can’t put you in.
sentences.cn: 所以我不能用你。

sentences.en: I just want you to know why.”
sentences.cn: 我只是想让你知道原因。”

sentences.en: The truth is, I was pretty devastated.
sentences.cn: 说实话，我相当崩溃。

sentences.en: Even though I wanted to go home, I was ready to give everything for United and Sir Alex in that match.
sentences.cn: 虽然我想回家，但那场比赛我本已准备好为曼联、为弗格森爵士拼上一切。

sentences.en: It was my dream to play at the Camp Nou in the Champions League.
sentences.cn: 在诺坎普踢欧冠是我的梦想。

sentences.en: It hurt very badly.
sentences.cn: 那一下真的很痛。

sentences.en: But in the end, Sir Alex made the right decision.
sentences.cn: 但到头来，弗格森爵士做了正确的决定。

sentences.en: Everything worked out for the best for everyone.
sentences.cn: 结果对每个人都好。

sentences.en: We got a 0-0 draw at the Camp Nou, and then we eliminated Barca at Old Trafford.
sentences.cn: 我们在诺坎普0比0逼平，然后在老特拉福德淘汰了巴萨。

sentences.en: We went on to win both the Champions League and the Premier League, and I was able to go home under very good circumstances.
sentences.cn: 我们接着把欧冠和英超都收入囊中，而我也能在非常体面的处境下回家。

sentences.en: Because of Sir Alex, I experienced one of the rarest things in football.
sentences.cn: 因为弗格森爵士，我经历了足球世界里最罕见的事情之一。

sentences.en: I left in the best way possible.
sentences.cn: 我以最好的方式离开。

sentences.en: It didn’t feel like it at the time, but that mistake against Bolton was the best thing to happen in my life.
sentences.cn: 当时不觉得，但对博尔顿的那次失误，是我人生中发生的最好的事。

sentences.en: In the end, Barcelona paid only $5 million for me.
sentences.cn: 最后，巴萨只花了500万美元就把我签了回来。

sentences.en: I arrived as the fourth-choice center back.
sentences.cn: 我回来时是第四号中卫。

sentences.en: No one expected much from me.
sentences.cn: 没人对我抱什么期望。

sentences.en: But thanks to Pep Guardiola’s football brain and his belief in me, I was playing alongside Carles Puyol by the end of the season.
sentences.cn: 但多亏瓜迪奥拉的足球头脑和他对我的信任，赛季末我已经在和卡莱斯·普约尔搭档了。

sentences.en: Carles took me under his wing and was a huge influence on me.
sentences.cn: 卡莱斯把我护在翅膀底下，对我影响巨大。

sentences.en: I learned so much from him, and we formed a partnership that extended to the Spanish national team.
sentences.cn: 我从他身上学到太多，我们的搭档关系一直延续到西班牙国家队。

sentences.en: If you would have told me when I returned to Barcelona that, in two years, I would be standing next to Puyol lifting the World Cup trophy, I would have thought you were absolutely crazy.
sentences.cn: 如果我回巴萨的时候你告诉我：两年后，我会站在普约尔身边举起世界杯——我一定觉得你彻底疯了。

sentences.en: But football is a funny business, and that is exactly what happened.
sentences.cn: 但足球就是这么有意思的行当，事情恰恰就这样发生了。

sentences.en: That’s how quickly everything changed for me.
sentences.cn: 我的境遇变化就是这么快。

sentences.en: And it really makes me think about fate.
sentences.cn: 这真的让我思考命运。

sentences.en: If I don’t make that mistake against Bolton, does it work out that way?
sentences.cn: 如果我没有在对博尔顿的比赛里犯那个错，事情还会这样发展吗？

sentences.en: If Sir Alex decides to keep me on for another season to get a bigger transfer fee for me, does it work out that way?
sentences.cn: 如果弗格森爵士为了多卖我一笔转会费而把我多留一个赛季，事情还会这样发展吗？

sentences.en: There are so many things that happen in a footballer’s life that people don’t see.
sentences.cn: 球员的人生里有太多人们看不见的事。

sentences.en: And that’s why I’m writing this.
sentences.cn: 这正是我写下这些的原因。

sentences.en: And that is why I need to tell you another quick story…
sentences.cn: 这也是为什么我还需要再给你讲一个小故事……

sentences.en: Because, as I said, football is very complicated.
sentences.cn: 因为正如我说的，足球非常复杂。

sentences.en: It’s not like the movies.
sentences.cn: 它不像电影。

sentences.en: When I was 24 years old, I was on top of the world.
sentences.cn: 二十四岁那年，我站在世界之巅。

sentences.en: I had won everything — La Liga, Champions League, World Cup.
sentences.cn: 我什么都赢过了——西甲、欧冠、世界杯。

sentences.en: I was playing under a genius manager in Pep Guardiola, who really believed in me from the moment I arrived.
sentences.cn: 我在一个天才主教练瓜迪奥拉手下踢球，他从我到来的那一刻就真的信任我。

sentences.en: I was playing for the club I had loved since I was a boy.
sentences.cn: 我效力的是我从小爱着的俱乐部。

sentences.en: It was perfect.
sentences.cn: 一切完美。

sentences.en: And then…
sentences.cn: 然后……

sentences.en: I had the worst season of my career.
sentences.cn: 我迎来了职业生涯最糟糕的一个赛季。

sentences.en: Everything seemed to fall apart in 2012.
sentences.cn: 2012年，一切仿佛崩塌了。

sentences.en: I don’t know why.
sentences.cn: 我不知道为什么。

sentences.en: Perhaps I had lost the fear that drove me to that level.
sentences.cn: 也许我丢失了那股把我推到那个高度的恐惧感。

sentences.en: But for whatever reason, I started questioning myself.
sentences.cn: 但不管什么原因，我开始怀疑自己。

sentences.en: As the season went on, Pep started to lose faith in me.
sentences.cn: 随着赛季推进，瓜迪奥拉开始对我失去信心。

sentences.en: For the first three seasons, we had a phenomenal relationship.
sentences.cn: 头三个赛季，我们的关系好得不得了。

sentences.en: I still revere Pep as a manager.
sentences.cn: 至今我仍敬重瓜帅这个教练。

sentences.en: But the truth is, it was an extremely hard time.
sentences.cn: 但说实话，那是一段极其艰难的时期。

sentences.en: He wanted his players to be obsessed with football 24 hours a day, and at that point in my life, I didn’t understand it.
sentences.cn: 他要球员一天24小时都为足球痴迷，而在人生的那个阶段，我不理解这一点。

sentences.en: I wasn’t as committed to that philosophy.
sentences.cn: 我没有那么认同那套哲学。

sentences.en: Pep simply didn’t trust me anymore, and the crucial moment was when he decided not to play me against Real Madrid in the league.
sentences.cn: 瓜帅就是不再信任我了，关键时刻是他决定在联赛里对皇马不让我上场。

sentences.en: That was crushing to me.
sentences.cn: 那对我打击巨大。

sentences.en: I started to think, Is this it?
sentences.cn: 我开始想：就这样了吗？

sentences.en: Is the dream of playing for Barca over?
sentences.cn: 为巴萨踢球的梦就这么结束了？

sentences.en: Is this how fast it can go away?
sentences.cn: 一切消逝得能这么快？

sentences.en: Then, in the second leg of the Champions League semifinal against Chelsea, something pretty crazy happened.
sentences.cn: 然后，欧冠半决赛对切尔西的第二回合，一件相当疯狂的事发生了。

sentences.en: Another turn of fate.
sentences.cn: 又一次命运的转弯。

sentences.en: We had lost 1–0 in the first leg at Stamford Bridge, and I didn’t play.
sentences.cn: 首回合我们在斯坦福桥0比1输了，我没有上场。

sentences.en: Pep started me in the second leg at the Camp Nou to try to turn things around, but I honestly cannot tell you anything about the match.
sentences.cn: 第二回合在诺坎普，瓜帅让我首发，想力挽狂澜——但说实话，那场比赛的任何事我都讲不出来。

sentences.en: Early on in the game, our keeper, Víctor Valdés, accidentally kneed me in the head during a clearance.
sentences.cn: 比赛early阶段，我们的门将维克托·巴尔德斯解围时一膝盖撞在我头上。

sentences.en: I was knocked completely unconscious.
sentences.cn: 我彻底失去了意识。

sentences.en: When I got to my feet, I stayed in the game somehow, and I know that I ran around for about 10 minutes, but I truly cannot remember anything that happened.
sentences.cn: 我爬起来，不知怎么继续留在场上，我知道自己又跑了大概十分钟，但我真的完全不记得发生了什么。

sentences.en: Eventually, the doctor noticed that I was struggling and they pulled me out and put me on a stretcher and rushed me to the hospital.
sentences.cn: 最后队医看出我不对劲，把我抬上担架，火速送去了医院。

sentences.en: I woke up the next day, and I couldn’t remember anything from the match.
sentences.cn: 第二天醒来，比赛的事我一点都想不起来。

sentences.en: I couldn’t even remember who won.
sentences.cn: 我连谁赢了都不记得。

sentences.en: I was in a complete fog.
sentences.cn: 整个人一片迷雾。

sentences.en: It turns out, the match ended 2–2, and we were knocked out.
sentences.cn: 后来才知道，那场球2比2，我们被淘汰了。

sentences.en: Within a few days, Pep announced his departure from Barca.
sentences.cn: 几天之内，瓜帅宣布离开巴萨。

sentences.en: It felt like an era was coming to an end, and I thought that perhaps my time was up, too.
sentences.cn: 感觉一个时代要落幕了，我寻思也许我的时代也到头了。

sentences.en: That season really made me think about my career, and my life.
sentences.cn: 那个赛季真的让我重新审视我的职业生涯，和我的人生。

sentences.en: It was a wake-up call.
sentences.cn: 它是一记警钟。

sentences.en: When our team was playing for it all, Pep didn’t believe in me anymore.
sentences.cn: 当球队为一切而战的时候，瓜帅不再相信我。

sentences.en: Then, when he finally turned to me, I got knocked out cold.
sentences.cn: 等他终于肯用我的时候，我被打得不省人事。

sentences.en: Sometimes I think about what would have happened if I had woken up the next day and found out that we had gone through against Chelsea.
sentences.cn: 有时我会想，如果第二天醒来，我得知我们淘汰了切尔西晋级了，会怎么样。

sentences.en: I was out with a head injury for weeks, so I definitely wouldn’t have played in the final.
sentences.cn: 我因为头部伤势缺席了几周，决赛我肯定打不了。

sentences.en: Maybe we would have won the Champions League.
sentences.cn: 也许我们会赢下那届欧冠。

sentences.en: Maybe Pep would have decided to stay at Barca.
sentences.cn: 也许瓜帅会决定留在巴萨。

sentences.en: Maybe he never would have regained his trust in me.
sentences.cn: 也许他永远不会重新信任我。

sentences.en: Maybe I would be at another club right now.
sentences.cn: 也许我现在人在另一家俱乐部。

sentences.en: Instead, Tito Vilanova arrived as the manager the next season, and he gave me a chance to regain my place.
sentences.cn: 现实是，下一个赛季蒂托·比拉诺瓦来了，他给了我夺回位置的机会。

sentences.en: There are so many moments like this that happen during a long career that make you think about fate, and chance, and how things could have gone differently.
sentences.cn: 漫长的职业生涯里，有太多这样的时刻，让你思考命运、机缘，以及事情本可能怎样不同。

sentences.en: But that’s not what we read in the headlines.
sentences.cn: 但这不是头条里的世界。

sentences.en: In the headlines, things are simple.
sentences.cn: 在头条里，事情都很简单。

sentences.en: In real life, the most interesting things are happening beneath the surface.
sentences.cn: 在真实生活里，最有意思的东西都藏在表面之下。

sentences.en: For example, people often ask me what it has been like playing with Messi for so many years.
sentences.cn: 举个例子，人们总问我，和梅西一起踢了这么多年球是什么感受。

sentences.en: If I had to explain it in one sentence: He is an alien.
sentences.cn: 如果要我用一句话解释：他是外星人。

sentences.en: He is not from this planet.
sentences.cn: 他不是这个星球的人。

sentences.en: He’s the only player that I can recall seeing play for the first time, way back when we were 13 years old, and saying to myself, “Oh, this kid comes from somewhere else.
sentences.cn: 他是我唯一记得的、第一次看就让我对自己说“哦，这孩子是从别处来的”的球员——那时我们才十三岁。

sentences.en: This is not human.”
sentences.cn: 这不是人类。

sentences.en: He is an assassin.
sentences.cn: 他是个刺客。

sentences.en: He’s the greatest I’ve ever seen.
sentences.cn: 他是我见过最伟大的球员。

sentences.en: But, you see, it’s not about the way he attacks.
sentences.cn: 但你看，关键不在他的进攻。

sentences.en: People ask me, “What’s the most incredible thing I’ve seen Leo do on the pitch?” And they expect me to tell them about him dribbling three defenders.
sentences.cn: 人们问我：“你在场上见过莱奥做的最不可思议的事是什么？”他们期待我讲他连过三名后卫的故事。

sentences.en: And trust me, I have plenty of those stories.
sentences.cn: 放心，那种故事我有一箩筐。

sentences.en: But for me, the reason that I know he’s from another planet is because of what happens when he doesn’t have the ball.
sentences.cn: 但对我来说，我知道他来自另一个星球的证据，是他无球时发生的事。

sentences.en: Perhaps you can’t see it on TV, but I can see it on the pitch.
sentences.cn: 在电视上你也许看不见，但在球场上我看得见。

sentences.en: You have to see his face when he’s sprinting to win the ball back from a defender.
sentences.cn: 你必须看他的脸——当他冲刺着从后卫脚下把球抢回来的时候。

sentences.en: He has a look in his eyes that I haven’t ever seen in another footballer.
sentences.cn: 他眼里的那种神情，我在任何别的球员身上都没见过。

sentences.en: It is what makes him so great.
sentences.cn: 这正是他伟大的原因。

sentences.en: He is not interested in the spectacle.
sentences.cn: 他对表演没有兴趣。

sentences.en: He rarely even does stepovers.
sentences.cn: 他甚至很少踩单车。

sentences.en: He’s cut from a different cloth.
sentences.cn: 他根本就不是同一种材料造出来的。

sentences.en: His greatness is in his obsession with winning the ball.
sentences.cn: 他的伟大，藏在他对抢回皮球的痴迷里。

sentences.en: Maybe that doesn’t make for a great headline.
sentences.cn: 也许这上不了大标题。

sentences.en: But when I think about Messi’s true magic, it’s not in something you can find on YouTube.
sentences.cn: 但当我想到梅西真正的魔力，它不是你在 YouTube 上能搜到的东西。

sentences.en: It’s about a subtle expression in his eyes.
sentences.cn: 它在他眼里一闪而过的细微神情。

sentences.en: His greatness would take me another 5,000 words to explain.
sentences.cn: 他的伟大够我再写五千字。

sentences.en: Perhaps in another article!
sentences.cn: 也许下篇文章再写吧！

sentences.en: And that brings me back to the beginning.
sentences.cn: 这又把话题带回了开头。

sentences.en: As I get older and prepare for the final World Cup of my career, I have been thinking about my place in the world.
sentences.cn: 年纪渐长，着手准备职业生涯最后一届世界杯，我一直在思考自己在这个世界上的位置。

sentences.en: I have been thinking about how I got here, and what else I want to accomplish in life.
sentences.cn: 我一直在想我是怎么走到今天的，以及这辈子我还想完成什么。

sentences.en: As athletes, I believe that we should use our platform to connect with people and let them into our lives and into our minds a little bit more.
sentences.cn: 作为运动员，我认为我们应该善用自己的平台，和人们连接，让他们更多走进我们的生活、我们的头脑。

sentences.en: I think this mentality is needed now more than ever.
sentences.cn: 我觉得这种心态现在比以往任何时候都更需要。

sentences.en: If you watch television in Madrid, the media will tell you that everyone in Barcelona is trying to destroy the country.
sentences.cn: 如果你在马德里看电视，媒体会告诉你，巴塞罗那的所有人都在试图毁掉这个国家。

sentences.en: If you watch television in Barcelona, they will tell you that everyone in Madrid is trying to oppress the people.
sentences.cn: 如果你在巴塞罗那看电视，他们会告诉你，马德里的所有人都在试图压迫人民。

sentences.en: Everyone is the bad guy now, depending on where you watch TV.
sentences.cn: 现在，坏人在哪边都有，就看你电视开在哪个台。

sentences.en: They say the national team is in turmoil because of political differences.
sentences.cn: 他们说国家队因为政治分歧陷入动荡。

sentences.en: In truth, we almost never talk about politics.
sentences.cn: 实际上，我们几乎从不聊政治。

sentences.en: I’m too busy telling the Real guys that they’re f***ed in the league, and they’re too busy talking to me about refereeing conspiracies!
sentences.cn: 我忙着告诉皇马那帮人这赛季你们完蛋了，他们也忙着跟我掰扯裁判阴谋论呢！

sentences.en: I’ve been a footballer for more than half my life.
sentences.cn: 我当球员的时间，已经超过人生的一半。

sentences.en: I’m 31 years old now.
sentences.cn: 我今年31岁。

sentences.en: I used to say that I would be retired by 30.
sentences.cn: 我从前总说自己三十岁就退役。

sentences.en: Honestly, do you know what keeps me going?
sentences.cn: 说实话，你知道是什么让我继续踢下去吗？

sentences.en: It’s the experiences I’ve had in the locker rooms.
sentences.cn: 是我在更衣室里经历的那些事。

sentences.en: It’s getting to know footballing geniuses like Messi, and Puyol, and Neymar, and Roy Keane (even though he almost murdered me).
sentences.cn: 是能够认识梅西、普约尔、内马尔这样的足球天才，还有罗伊·基恩（尽管他差点杀了我）。

sentences.en: In the end, football is a long trip.
sentences.cn: 说到底，足球是一场漫长的旅行。

sentences.en: You win.
sentences.cn: 你会赢。

sentences.en: You lose.
sentences.cn: 你会输。

sentences.en: You embarrass yourself.
sentences.cn: 你会出丑。

sentences.en: You make mistakes.
sentences.cn: 你会犯错。

sentences.en: You laugh, you cry.
sentences.cn: 你笑，你哭。

sentences.en: You do dumb things to pass the time.
sentences.cn: 你干各种傻事打发时间。

sentences.en: Maybe you and your teammates even set an assistant coach’s motorcycle on fire (before buying him a brand new one, of course…
sentences.cn: 说不定你们全队还会把助理教练的摩托车点着了火（当然，事后又给他买了辆全新的……

sentences.en: I’ll leave that story for another time!)
sentences.cn: 这个故事改天再讲！）

sentences.en: Hopefully, you grow from a boy to a man.
sentences.cn: 但愿你从一个男孩长成了一个男人。

sentences.en: This is what makes sports beautiful, for me.
sentences.cn: 这就是体育之于我的美。

sentences.en: It’s all just one long story.
sentences.cn: 这一切，本就是一个漫长的故事。

sentences.en: Welcome to The Players’ Tribune Global.
sentences.cn: 欢迎来到《球员论坛报》全球版。

sentences.en: One of my goals is to never shut up.
sentences.cn: 我的目标之一，是永远不闭嘴。
